verdict.rationale: No first-party benchmarks or published latency/throughput figures appear in the evidence. Measured numbers only surface secondhand in community comments: one cites third-party benchmarks, with an older one showing Ghostty had the worst input latency and a newer one showing about 13ms average. Another says throughput is in Alacritty's league, and an anecdotal report says input lag is higher than xfce4-terminal. Missing for 10: official published benchmark methodology and results, first-party latency/throughput numbers backing performance claims, direct links to the independent benchmark data.
